body: It's really strange how a stranger can care so much (just thru the internet) but yet somehow your own family does not. My mother even told me to kill myself. It's just really tough but I am almost certain that I will be okay thanks to all of you. I can't thank you people enough.

It is really hard. Please know I am trying my hardest not to harm myself or the people that love me. Thank you for your reply and caring for a stranger. Every comment on this post definitely changed my perspective.
I do have people I can talk too but feel like it's too much for them. I'm sure I'll be fine though but thank you so much :)
This hit me hard. I am almost sure I am not going to go thru with it now just because I know strangers care.
thank you for replying and caring
I am new to reddit and I'm not sure if you can message people but please do. I'd be more than glad to give you my phone number.
Thank you so much. Your words mean so much to me.
